verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
There's a new song rising
A new song rising

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I woke up in darkness
Surrounded by silence
Oh where, where have I gone?

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I woke to reality losing its grip on me
Oh where, where have I gone?
Cause I can see the light
Before I see the sunrise

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
You called and You shouted
Broke through my deafness
I'm breathing in and breathing out
I'm alive again

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
You shattered my darkness
Washed away my blindness
Now I'm breathing in and breathing out
I'm alive again

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Late have I loved You
You waited for me, I searched for You
What took me so long?

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
I was looking outside
As if Love would ever want to hide
I'm finding I was wrong
Cause I can feel the wind
Before it hits my skin

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Cause I want You, Yes I want You
And I need You and I'll do
Whatever I have to, just to get through
Cause I love You, yeah I love You
